title: Act: Render the empty history message in ContributionSheet
summary: Add a conditional empty-state paragraph above the suggestions list
description: Add a paragraph rendered only when historyStatus === 'ready' and entries.length === 0, with the text 'No suggestions yet this round'. Product code only.
acceptance_criteria: The message renders when status is ready and entries is empty.
The message is absent when status is loading or error, or entries is non-empty.

steps.action: Add a module constant HISTORY_EMPTY holding the empty-state text, next to HISTORY_LOADING and HISTORY_ERROR.
steps.code: const HISTORY_EMPTY = 'No suggestions yet this round';
steps.expected: HISTORY_EMPTY is defined with the exact text 'No suggestions yet this round'.

steps.action: After the historyStatus === 'error' Retry button block and before the <ul aria-label="Your suggestions">, add a conditional paragraph shown only when historyStatus is 'ready' and entries.length is 0.
steps.expected: After an empty successful load the sheet shows 'No suggestions yet this round'; it disappears once any entry is in entries.
